# Routing Engine Contract

Routing engine selects UI framework, loads presentation layer, dispatches
commands, and binds content to panes. It does not render content or apply
styling.

## Responsibilities:

- interpret menu selection
- select ui_framework
- instantiate pane geometry
- load colour_scheme + border_pattern
- dispatch command
- bind content
- forward UI events

## Forbidden:

- rendering
- styling
- content modification
- UI-framework modification
